name: Cover 3 Press-Bail (Legion Foundation)
formation: 4-3 Under Front vs 21P Offset-I Wing Right
coverage: Cover 3 Sky (Press-Bail Corners, Strong Safety Force)

summary.motive: Suffocate explosive perimeter passing using physical press-bail cornerback technique and single-high Cover 3 Sky integrity while creating speed pressure with the Wide-9 LEO rusher.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Press-Bail Corner) & LEO (Wide-9 Speed Edge Rusher)
summary.whyItWorks: Press-bail eliminates quick boundary throws without conceding deep vertical separation, buying time for the 4-man defensive line rush to collapse the pocket.
summary.failureMode: Four verticals concepts attacking both seams simultaneously if the single-high free safety gets held by an eye-manipulating quarterback.

beats.title: Physical Press-Bail Alignment
beats.text: Dan Quinn deploys the iconic Seattle-style Cover 3: outside cornerbacks line up in suffocating press alignment at 1.5 yards, while the LEO edge rusher aligns in a Wide-9 track.

beats.title: Press-Bail Transition & Sky Rotation
beats.text: At the snap, both cornerbacks use disciplined side-saddle press-bail footwork to glide into deep thirds, while Strong Safety (SS) inserts aggressively downhill into the strong flat (Sky force).

beats.title: Deep Thirds Capped, Windows Clamped
beats.text: The QB wants to take a deep vertical shot vs press, but LCB and FS completely cap the boundary Go and field Post routes with zero daylight.

beats.title: LEO Strip-Sack from Blindside
beats.text: With all initial passing concepts locked down by the 7-man coverage shell, the unassisted 4-man rush arrives as LEO rips past the left tackle to strip the football.

relations.tell: Corners show hard press at line then open hips into side-saddle bail at snap while SS rotates downhill
